profile: Geotechnical and heavy civil specialist. Has tunnelled plenty — for sewers, intakes and cut-off walls. Its rail book is bridges and earthworks, and the two halves have never been on the same job.

projects.title: Auralia River Crossing Foundations
projects.narrative: Deep pile foundations and pier caps for a cable-stayed river crossing, with cofferdams in a tidal channel.

projects.title: Coastal Highway Realignment
projects.narrative: Highway realignment through unstable coastal slopes, with soil nailing, drainage galleries and instrumented monitoring.

projects.title: Metro Depot and Stabling Yard
projects.narrative: Ground improvement and civil works for a metro depot and stabling yard built on reclaimed land.

projects.title: Westside Sewer Interceptor
projects.narrative: Sewer interceptor driven by tunnel boring machine through mixed ground, with cross-passages to existing chambers.

projects.title: Port Berth Deepening
projects.narrative: Berth deepening and quay wall reinforcement at a working container port.

projects.title: Legacy Works Landfill Closure
projects.narrative: Landfill cap, gas collection and long-term consolidation monitoring at a decommissioned works.

projects.title: Hydroelectric Intake Refurbishment
projects.narrative: Intake and penstock refurbishment at an operating hydroelectric scheme, including shaft sinking through fractured rock.

projects.title: Freight Viaduct Reinforcement
projects.narrative: Viaduct reinforcement and bearing replacement across eleven spans on a freight corridor.

projects.title: Groundwater Remediation Barrier
projects.narrative: Secant pile cut-off wall and a pump-and-treat system around a legacy contamination plume.

projects.title: Corridor Protection Works
projects.narrative: Corridor protection works delivered under a security protocol; the alignment, the sites and the scope cannot be described to a third party.
